name: Grijota (Spain)
description: Square flag divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, crimson at the lower hoist and white at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Grijota (a castle on red).
history: Municipal flag of Grijota; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: castle and crown of the arms
